records.imp.impactDescription: RAN-2 should start with the baseline stage-2 specifications that can be derived from TR 38.874; these baseline specifications mainly affect TS 38.300. Architecture baseline (38.300) includes: relaying architecture and Interfaces; user- and control-plane aspects incl. protocol stacks and bearer-to-RLC-channel mapping; enhancements to L2 structures; enhancements to radio protocol sublayer (adaptation layer); radio-aware scheduling.

records.tr.scope: Study on Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) for Mobility in NR

records.impactType: Xn interface enhancement (Data Collection Reporting (Initiation) procedures)
records.description: Per TR 38.743 clause 4.1.2.5 (AI/ML-based Network Slicing use case), the output information of the AI/ML model that needs to be introduced and exchanged over the Xn interface — i.e., predicted radio resource status per slice and predicted slice available capacity — is to be enabled by enhancing the existing Rel-18 Data Collection Reporting (Initiation) procedures in TS 38.423, to allow requesting and reporting of this predicted information per slice over Xn. Resource management decisions for resources within RRM policies and slice aware mobility decisions remain internal output in the local node, hence there is no standard impact over Xn for them. For the feedback information (measured radio resource status per slice, measured slice available capacity, and legacy Rel-18 per-UE UE performance feedback), exchange over Xn is already supported by the standard (Radio Resource Status Reporting (Initiation) and Data Collection Reporting (Initiation) procedures).

records.conclusions: In this TR, failure scenarios in the existing gNB-CU-CP architecture from various perspectives were studied. Today's specification enables/allows the implementation to address the failure scenarios, and a failure affecting the entire (logical) gNB-CU-CP would impact all UEs served by the cells of the gNB-DUs connected to the gNB-CU-CP, resulting in those UEs being out of service for long periods of time.
